posts.title: New towns in the future of Kentucky
posts.description: The housing shortage and cost of living were Kentuckians' central concerns in the election. Elected officials had to tackle housing. The summit Mayors and judge executives met for a housing summit. The governor and state legislators were invited to the closing session. A few legislators attended, but it was a start. Topics included: Land use. Comprehensive planning. Demographic changes, population
